scope: BOUNDED_IPV4_TCP_SINGLE_FULL_DATA_PACKET_RX_BYTES_ONLY; NOT AUTHENTICATED RECORD OR NETWORK DRIVER

contract.supported: One caller-delimited whole IPv4 packet, IPv4 20B no options, TCP DATA with 20B header or exact session-negotiated timestamp options, one nonempty ciphertext payload; seq32 nearest to caller-supplied trusted seq64.
strict_checks: trusted unicast IPv4 tuple and nonzero ports
TCP/IPv4 actual src-dst tuple equals trusted cold state
IPv4 0x45 version-IHL, TOS zero, DF-only no fragment MF/offset, protocol6
exact total_length == actual byte length, max65535 and actual MTU
independent one’s-complement IPv4 and TCP+pseudoheader full checksum (odd/even)
TCP data-offset 20..60, reserved bits zero, DATA flags ACK|PSH, urgent ptr zero
options only exact authenticated snapshot (NOP/EOL/explicit timestamp allowed)
no empty TCP body or silent trailing/coalesced packet bytes
contract.seq: extend_seq32(anchor:u64,wire32:u32) computes signed modular nearest with strictly under 2^31, returns HalfSpaceAmbiguous exactly at 2^31 or OutsideU64 at bounds; never mutates trusted anchor.
contract.output: UnauthenticatedData<'a> borrows ciphertext slice (no copy or heap); checksum success is never AEAD or PN replay verification; M3/M0 owns authentication and actual delivery.
contract.no_stream: No TCP byte stream reconstruction, IP defragmentation, concatenated packet parse, OS RX syscall or packet synthesis.
